name: White Salmon River
blurb: Spring-fed, ice-cold Wild and Scenic river in a mossy basalt slot — the Gorge's summer rafting run.

sections.notes: Continuous Class III–III+ in a narrow basalt gorge. TAKE OUT ABOVE HUSUM FALLS (Class V) at the river-right USFS access. Commercial rafting run. USFS: no fees at BZ Corner or the Husum Boating Site for private boaters; commercial outfitters need a USFS special-use permit.
sections.mapPendingReason: Husum (above the falls): USFS Husum Boating Site page confirms public access above Husum Falls (no fee) and lists lat/lon 45.799923,-121.486067; on Esri imagery (2026-10-25) that is the SR 141 roadside pull-out ~25-30 m from the water, not a confirmed water's-edge take-out. Final run: USFS INFRA has the same point; no separate take-out coordinate.
